summary: Silynxcom filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release about delivering a $3 million purchase order for tactical communication solutions to an Asian military customer. The order, previously announced on December 12, 2025, is part of a broader army tender and has now been fully delivered. This is a routine operating update regarding product delivery and not a transformative corporate event. No special-situation transaction (acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, etc.) is present. The filing serves only as an ordinary business progress report and a foreign private issuer's compliance filing with no structural or financial reorganisation.
